purpose: Review official Bologna cadastral channels and qualify bounded anonymous parcel geometry evidence.
assessment: The official Comune di Bologna SIT CATASTO ArcGIS service was identified and queried anonymously. Its parcel layer returned a Bologna polygon in a point-intersection request around the unchanged WUP point. This is local public geometry evidence, not a citywide completeness claim.
registryAssessment: A local registry/cadastral map custodian is evidenced: Comune di Bologna - Sistema Informativo Territoriale publishes the CATASTO MapServer and parcel layer. This is distinct from general national cadastral agency prose.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official service metadata, parcel schema inspection, and one bounded anonymous point query around the immutable WUP point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: One safe Bologna polygon with cadastral composite identity and parcel components was returned.

officialPrimarySources.scope: Official municipal CATASTO ArcGIS MapServer and Bologna service extent.
Parcel polygon layer schema, safe field list, and native EPSG:23032 metadata.

attempts: Fetched the official municipal CATASTO MapServer metadata anonymously; HTTP 200.
Fetched parcel layer metadata anonymously; HTTP 200; observed Polygon geometry, native EPSG:23032, and safe cadastral fields.
Sent one anonymous TLS-verified point-intersection query at the unchanged WUP point transformed only for the service CRS; requested safe fields and GeoJSON output in EPSG:4326; HTTP 200.
Observed one Bologna result with COMUNE=A944, FOGLIO=187, MAPPALE=296 and PARTKEY=A944_ 187  296; retained one unchanged source polygon with only canonical id property.
An initial bounded envelope request was rejected with HTTP 400 because this legacy layer does not support pagination; this was not treated as a source failure, and the bounded point query succeeded.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal field was used or retained.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: A point-intersection request using the unchanged WUP point returned a Bologna parcel polygon; this is not an absence or completeness test.

requestEvidence.method: GET; anonymous; TLS verified; safe outFields; outSR=4326; f=geojson

nextStep: Root/serial review should independently qualify the public route, CRS/order, composite identity stability, rate limits, and bounded coverage before any adapter admission. Keep runtime held until then.
remainingUncertainty: One local point query cannot establish citywide completeness or freshness; behavior outside the tested vicinity was not assessed.
